visual_identity.core_identity: A small, lean reptilian humanoid built for ambushes and traps rather than brute force.
visual_identity.silhouette: Short but wiry body, long balancing tail, narrow shoulders, slightly hunched alert posture, long clawed feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Long narrow draconic snout, sharp small teeth, pronounced brow, swept horn nubs or short head spines, alert predatory eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean torso and limbs with visible reptilian anatomy; digitigrade-looking legs and clawed hands and feet.
visual_identity.surface: Scaled skin suggested with sparse, simple scale marks rather than dense texture.
signature_gear: light scavenged armor or belt pouches

accuracy_checks: horns or head spines are visible
body reads reptilian rather than furry

reference.notes: Reference art controls anatomy and silhouette, never rendering style. Black-Ink house style controls the final line-art treatment.
